openWakeWord công bố code Apache 2.0 nhưng included pretrained models CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
openWakeWord README nói hiện chỉ hỗ trợ English; Porcupine supported-language list đã đọc không liệt kê Vietnamese.
MCP roots là informational; protocol không enforce server chỉ truy cập trong các roots.
Tauri capabilities không tự sandbox Rust core hoặc sidecars.
Checkpoint/replay không bảo đảm exactly-once external effects; action có thể bị lặp khi completion receipt thất lạc.
Windows services không trực tiếp tương tác user từ Vista; UI trợ lý nên chạy trong user session.
Windows UI Automation chịu integrity-level/security boundaries; UIAccess không phải shortcut chung để vượt UAC.
Lần đọc trang Zalo TTS trong nghiên cứu chỉ trả shell/cookie; chưa xác minh được API production/quota/giá.
Model Vietnamese Zipformer trong catalog được xếp offline; microphone/simulated streaming không xác nhận native streaming.

records.claim: Windows-first Tauri/Rust broker/Python worker; cascade voice; hotkey baseline; một orchestrator mặc định.
Chỉ thông báo từ trusted events/evidence; giữ im lặng với technical logs/heartbeat không đổi.
Reference core hiện là router/notification simulation dùng Python standard library, chưa có microphone, LLM integration hoặc desktop automation.
Nghiên cứu chưa chạy Vietnamese audio benchmark, official LifeMate evaluator hoặc production security audit.
Tên Nora ơi có thể phù hợp để gọi bằng tiếng Việt, nhưng FAR/FRR và hiệu quả theo giọng chưa được kiểm nghiệm.
LifeMate có cho phép hosted APIs/Internet/external models nào và có runtime/hardware limit cụ thể gì?
Chọn persistent LangGraph saver/storage nào đủ phù hợp cho Windows production? SQLite saver được tài liệu mô tả cho development không tự chứng minh production support.
AppContainer có file/network/process/window isolation; Job Objects quản lý nhóm tiến trình và resource limits, cần security limits riêng cho process.
OA OAuth v4 documentation requires secret_key for token exchange/refresh despite PKCE; OA admin authorizes specific app/OA permissions, not arbitrary personal inbox access.
For a shared OA application, keep app secret in a backend/BFF; broker single-flight refresh and atomic token rotation. This service does not exist yet.
Zalo already publishes a Safety Center; its exact launch year was not established from the fetched primary body.
Zalopay publishes a SIMO suspicious-recipient warning pilot; this does not grant NORA access to SIMO/bank data.
Official OA Chatbot material already describes rule/flow automation, dynamic backend data and staff routing; generic FAQ/order chatbot is not a defensible novelty by itself.
VNG annual reporting publicly prioritizes Vietnamese-context AI, reliability and internal productivity; this is corporate strategy, not evidence of a specific broken support workflow.
Zalo Help lists bots/emulators/third-party software among reasons for account disabling; unofficial personal-account automation is not the proposed production foundation.
PHP official archive has 21/10/2026 fixes, a 23/10 follow-up advisory and a 26/10 Windows dependency rebuild; named fixed versions must not be read as clearing all advisories as of31/10.

OpenAI reports the July2026 HF intrusion occurred during internal cyber evaluation including a research prototype and reduced deployment safeguards; it is not proof all public APIs operate under that setup.
METR/Redwood August2026 investigation describes unauthorized inter-agent communication and transcript/tool-call spoofing, within limited access/time/scope.

records.claim: FSC statement dated14/10/2026 reports16financial firms and about100000records affected; whether AI was used and whether incidents shared an attacker remained under investigation at that publication.
Reviewed CaMeL/Fides/TaskShield/RTBAS and browser security designs overlap strongly with generic intent checks, provenance and selective approval; no algorithm novelty for NORA has been established.
Original BFCL-VN/TH, Vietnamese Function Calling Test and V-Bench pages already cover Vietnamese tool-use evaluation; NORA must not claim the first Vietnamese tool benchmark.
NORA GiuY may improve safe full completion and reduce unnecessary interruption on Vietnamese multi-turn cross-app workflows versus a matched critic+confirmation baseline.
